Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

name: Presence of Mind
tooltip: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

name: Arcane Power
tooltip: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

name: Fireball
tooltip: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 425 to 541 Fire damage and an additional 60 Fire damage over 8 sec.

name: Fire Blast
tooltip: Blasts the enemy for 402 to 474 Fire damage.

name: Flamestrike
tooltip: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 375 to 459 Fire damage and an additional 332 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.

name: Fire Ward
tooltip: Absorbs 913 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Pyroblast
tooltip: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 520 to 646 Fire damage and an additional 212 Fire damage over 12 sec.

name: Scorch
tooltip: Scorch the enemy for 163 to 193 Fire damage.

name: Blast Wave
tooltip: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 453 to 533 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

name: Frostfire Bolt
tooltip: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 270 to 314 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 57 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.

name: Felfire
tooltip: Blasts the enemy for 500 Fire damage.

name: Combustion
tooltip: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

name: Frost Armor
tooltip: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

name: Frostbolt
tooltip: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 457 to 493 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

name: Frost Nova
tooltip: Blasts enemies near the caster for 69 to 77 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

name: Blizzard
tooltip: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 1168 Frost damage over 8 sec.

name: Ice Lance
tooltip: Deals 133 to 157 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

name: Frost Ward
tooltip: Absorbs 913 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Cone of Cold
tooltip: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 325 to 355 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec.

name: Ice Armor
tooltip: Increases Armor by 560 and frost resistance by 15. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

name: Ice Barrier
tooltip: Instantly shields you, absorbing 811 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

name: Ice Block
tooltip: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

name: Cold Snap
tooltip: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

name: Comprehend Scroll
tooltip: Decipher an untranslated scroll.

name: Study
tooltip: Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls. Requires a suitable library.

name: Corruption
tooltip: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

name: Curse of Weakness
tooltip: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Life Tap
tooltip: Converts 420 health into 840 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount of Mana converted. Mana gained is increased by your Spirit.

name: Bane of Agony
tooltip: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Fear
tooltip: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

name: Drain Soul
tooltip: Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

name: Curse of Recklessness
tooltip: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Drain Life
tooltip: Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

name: Curse of the Elements
tooltip: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 60 and increases Magic damage taken by 8%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Drain Mana
tooltip: Transfers 42 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

name: Curse of Tongues
tooltip: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Siphon Life
tooltip: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Howl of Terror
tooltip: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

name: Death Coil
tooltip: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 454 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

name: Bane of Doom
tooltip: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Amplify Curse
tooltip: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Curse of Exhaustion
tooltip: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Wrack
tooltip: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Demon Skin
tooltip: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

name: Summon Imp
tooltip: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

name: Create Healthstone
tooltip:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1440 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

name: Summon Voidwalker
tooltip: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

name: Health Funnel
tooltip: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.

name: Unending Breath
tooltip: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

name: Create Soulstone
tooltip:
Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2200 health and 2800 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

name: Demon Armor
tooltip: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

name: Ritual of Summoning
tooltip: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

name: Summon Incubus
tooltip: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

name: Summon Succubus
tooltip: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

name: Eye of Kilrogg
tooltip: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

name: Sense Demons
tooltip: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

name: Detect Invisibility
tooltip: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

name: Banish
tooltip: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

name: Create Firestone
tooltip: Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.

name: Subjugate Demon
tooltip: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 62, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

name: Summon Felhunter
tooltip: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

name: Shadow Ward
tooltip: Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Create Spellstone
tooltip:
Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

name: Inferno
tooltip: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

name: Portal of Summoning
tooltip: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member. The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

name: Ritual of Doom
tooltip: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

name: Demonic Sacrifice
tooltip:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hr. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

name: Fel Domination
tooltip: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

name: Soul Link
tooltip: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

name: Immolate
tooltip: Burns the enemy for 158 Fire damage and then an additional 275 Fire damage over 15 sec.

name: Shadow Bolt
tooltip: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 253 to 283 Shadow damage.

name: Searing Pain
tooltip: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 105 to 123 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

name: Rain of Fire
tooltip: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 880 Fire damage over 8 sec.

name: Shadowburn
tooltip: Instantly blasts the target for 251 to 281 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

name: Conflagrate
tooltip: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 172 to 216 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

name: Hellfire
tooltip: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 206 Fire damage to himself and 206 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

name: Incinerate
tooltip: Deals 201 to 233 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

name: Soul Fire
tooltip: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 383 to 479 Fire damage.

name: Bane of Havoc
tooltip: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

name: Summon Felsteed
tooltip: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

name: Summon Dreadsteed
tooltip: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

name: Wrath
tooltip: Causes 58 to 64 Nature damage to the target.

name: Moonfire
tooltip: Burns the enemy for 124 to 146 Arcane damage and then an additional 240 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

name: Thorns
tooltip: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 22 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

name: Entangling Roots
tooltip: Roots the target in place and causes 234 Nature damage over 27 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time.

name: Nature's Grasp
tooltip: The next 1 melee attacks that strike the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 6). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

name: Teleport: Moonglade
tooltip: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

name: Faerie Fire
tooltip: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

name: Hibernate
tooltip: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

name: Insect Swarm
tooltip: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 186 Nature damage over 12 sec.

name: Omen of Clarity
tooltip: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.

name: Starfire
tooltip: Causes 350 to 412 Arcane damage to the target.

name: Soothe Animal
tooltip: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

name: Hurricane
tooltip: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 132 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

name: Barkskin
tooltip: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

name: Moonkin Form
tooltip:
Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form, the armor contribution from items is increased by 360%, Omen of Clarity gains 100% increased chance to trigger, and all party members within 45 yards have their critical strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

name: Bear Form
tooltip:
Shapeshift into a bear, increasing melee attack power by 30, armor contribution from items by 180%, and health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

name: Demoralizing Roar
tooltip: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 193. Lasts 30 sec.

name: Growl
tooltip: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

name: Maul
tooltip: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.

name: Enrage
tooltip: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

name: Bash
tooltip: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

name: Aquatic Form
tooltip:
Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

name: Swipe
tooltip: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 83 damage.

name: Cat Form
tooltip:
Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 12 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

name: Claw
tooltip: Claw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 115. Awards 1 combo points.

name: Prowl
tooltip: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

name: Rip
tooltip:
Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:
1 point : 243 damage over 12 sec.
2 points: 396 damage over 12 sec.
3 points: 549 damage over 12 sec.
4 points: 702 damage over 12 sec.
5 points: 855 damage over 12 sec.

name: Shred
tooltip: Shred the target, causing 155% damage plus 180 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo points.

name: Rake
tooltip: Rake the target for 61 damage and an additional 102 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo points.

name: Tiger's Fury
tooltip:
Requires Cat Form
Increases Physical damage done by 15% for 6 sec.

name: Dash
tooltip: Increases movement speed by 60% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

name: Challenging Roar
tooltip: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

name: Cower
tooltip: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

name: Travel Form
tooltip:
Transforms the druid into a travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

name: Ferocious Bite
tooltip:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 2.0 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
1 point : 122-162 damage
2 points: 214-254 damage
3 points: 306-346 damage
4 points: 398-438 damage
5 points: 490-530 damage

name: Ravage
tooltip: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 343 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo points.

name: Track Humanoids
tooltip: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

name: Pounce
tooltip: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 150 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo points.

name: Dire Bear Form
tooltip:
Shapeshift into a dire bear, increasing melee attack power by 120, armor contribution from items by 360%, and health by 600. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

name: Feline Grace
tooltip: Reduces damage from falling.

name: Lacerate
tooltip: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 75 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

name: Feral Charge
tooltip:
Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

Leap behind an enemy.

name: Mangle
tooltip: Mangle the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.

name: Berserk
tooltip:
Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Causes your Mangle ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

name: Healing Touch
tooltip: Heals a friendly target for 2139 to 2525.

name: Mark of the Wild
tooltip: Increases the friendly target's armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hr.

name: Rejuvenation
tooltip: Heals the target for 776 over 12 sec.

name: Regrowth
tooltip: Heals a friendly target for 965 to 1077 and another 994 over 21 sec.

name: Revive
tooltip: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Cure Poison
tooltip: Cures 1 poison effects on the target.

name: Rebirth
tooltip: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 2200 health and 2800 mana.

name: Remove Curse
tooltip: Dispels 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

name: Abolish Poison
tooltip: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

name: Tranquility
tooltip: Regenerates all nearby party members within 20 yards for 285 every 2 sec for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

name: Innervate
tooltip: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

name: Wild Growth
tooltip: Heals the target and their party for 679 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

name: Gift of the Wild
tooltip: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hr.

name: Swiftmend
tooltip: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

name: Nature's Swiftness
tooltip: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.
